# @singitai/opencode

OpenCode plugin for SingIt: pay-per-request LLM access via x402 micropayments, routed through a local proxy. No API keys, no subscriptions.

## How it works

The plugin registers an OpenCode provider named `singit` that points at the local [SingIt proxy](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@singitai/proxy) (`@singitai/proxy`) running on `127.0.0.1:8787`. The proxy speaks the OpenAI-compatible API (`/v1/chat/completions`, `/v1/responses`) upstream to OpenCode, and settles each downstream request with an x402 micropayment in USDC on Base, signed from the wallet at `~/.singit/session`. Your private key never leaves your machine.

## Prerequisite

The SingIt proxy must be running before you select a `singit/*` model:

```bash
bun add -g @singitai/proxy   # or: npm install -g @singitai/proxy
singit-proxy                 # serves http://127.0.0.1:8787/v1
```

On first run the proxy creates a session wallet at `~/.singit/session`. Fund it with USDC on Base to start.

## Installation

```bash
bun add @singitai/opencode   # or: npm install @singitai/opencode
```

Then add it to your `opencode.json`:

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json",
  "plugins": ["@singitai/opencode"],
  "model": "singit/auto"
}
```

Or pick a model interactively in OpenCode: `/models` → `SingIt`.

## Models

| Model | Notes |
|---|---|
| `singit/auto` | Default. The proxy routes to the best available model for the request. |
| `singit/free/deepseek-v4.1-flash` | Free-tier model; no wallet balance required. |

## Spend ceilings

Enforced by the proxy, not this plugin:

| Variable | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `SINGIT_MAX_PER_CALL_USD` | `0.01` | Maximum USDC settled for a single request. |
| `SINGIT_MAX_PER_DAY_USD` | `1` | Maximum USDC settled per rolling day. |

Requests that would exceed a ceiling are rejected by the proxy before any payment is made.

To point the plugin at a proxy on a different address, set `SINGIT_PROXY_URL` (default `http://127.0.0.1:8787/v1`).

## Cost note

You pay only for what you use, per request, in USDC on Base. There is no subscription and no minimum balance beyond the per-call ceiling. A typical coding session fits well within the default daily ceiling of $1; the free-tier model costs nothing.
